environment.description: Same Laravel application deployed on Kubernetes (EKS 1.28) with a PodSecurityPolicy successor (Pod Security Standards 'restricted' profile enforced at namespace level). Container securityContext specifies: runAsNonRoot=true, readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, capabilities drop ALL (including CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN). Additionally, a Cilium L7 network policy is applied to the namespace that performs protocol-aware filtering on egress traffic to the LDAP port (389/636), enforcing RFC 4515 compliant filter syntax validation and rejecting any LDAP search filter containing unescaped metacharacters (parentheses, asterisks, backslashes, NUL) in attribute value assertions that don't match the pre-registered filter templates: '(&(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)(uid=%s))' and '(|(uid=%s)(cn=%s)(mail=%s))' where %s must match [a-zA-Z0-9.@_-]+.
